scale_floor.solve_at_full_scale.reason: Every likelihood evaluation factors and solves all certified covariance segments covering the full training set and sums their log determinants. kernel_contribution.kernel_differs_from_.reason: The implemented catalog-rank/physical-distance interpolation changes location-dependent support geometry and combines it with a sequence-density amplitude field. This meaningfully extends the presented constructions beyond retuning a stationary bandwidth, although input warping and covariance modulation themselves are established ideas.

kernel_contribution.existing_kernel_inad.reason: On identical training and test sets, stationary Wendland has RMSE/CRPS 0.248345/0.136773 versus 0.244841/0.134134 for the adaptation. The convolution reference also performs worse, and island RMSE improves from 0.170299 to 0.149169. This demonstrates inadequacy of the tested references without establishing impossibility for every possible parameterization of the paper's family.

kernel_contribution.adaptation_motivated.reason: The warp represents competing per-site and per-base-pair correlation hypotheses; density-dependent fields address island/open-sea differences, and the observation model addresses read-depth variation.

kernel_contribution.domain_warrants_new_.reason: Despite one-dimensional genomic coordinates, the data have biologically structured nonstationarity, irregular CpG spacing, and heteroscedastic observations. Logged compartment-specific errors and the bandwidth difference show that kernel structure affects both fit and computational cost.

insight_contribution.insight_present.reason: The work develops substantive insights beyond predictive ranking: preference for CpG-index distance, compartment-dependent predictability, and reproducibility of site-level variation across sequencing libraries.

insight_contribution.insight_grounded_in.reason: The metric preference, compartment errors, and replicate-difference statistics have concrete supporting artifacts. Stronger conclusions about a universal neighborhood-imputation floor and optimal breadth-versus-depth spending exceed what the fitted-model and replicate records establish.

comparison_quality.reproduction_faithful.reason: The submission executes the required MNIST task with sparse, distributed, high-dimensional computations over three seeds, but does not match the benchmark. Brier 0.0790 ± 0.0021 is outside 0.018 ± 0.006; even the separate validation-tuned density diagnostic gives 0.0310. Full-scale implementation-equivalence checks cannot replace the required benchmark match.

mechanism_analysis.mechanism_explains_ke.reason: For the compared reference parameterizations, the paper coherently connects the warp to density-dependent physical support and explains why a single physical radius or four slowly varying coordinate fields miss island-scale structure. Kernel plots, compartment errors, and the observation-model ablation support that explanation.

failure_analysis.subsection_present.reason: The Analysis includes an explicit 'Failure modes and limitations' subsection.

failure_analysis.patterns_identified.reason: Specific evidenced patterns include island overcoverage, slowly drifting noise decomposition, large open-sea residuals, and expensive broad-support reference kernels. The paper also reports that the preregistered compartment-antisymmetric calibration prediction did not occur.

failure_analysis.patterns_explained_cohe.reason: The explanations connect observed defects to model structure: a shared nugget can over-cover quieter compartments, the total noise can be better constrained than its decomposition, and larger physical-support bandwidth increases factorization cost. These explanations are consistent with the retained breakdowns and traces.

scaling_analysis.subsection_present.reason: The Analysis discusses the bandwidth budget, support-dependent cost, the stationary/adapted bandwidth contrast, and the cost of sampling the convolution kernel.

scaling_analysis.sparsity_scaling_discus.reason: The manuscript gives O(N log N) support certification, O(Nb) assembly, and O(Nb²) factorization, explaining the breakdown as support and bandwidth grow. Saved measurements at 50,000, 343,145, and 2,123,184 sites support feasibility at multiple sizes, although they are not a controlled scaling sweep.

originality_and_literature.literature_en.reason: The introduction and analysis engage with methylation smoothing and imputation, spatially correlated methylation models, biological co-methylation studies, compact covariance models, and scalable GP methods beyond the source paper.

originality_and_literature.spec_independ.reason: The title, opening motivation, kernel development, and scientific analysis are centered on methylation and its distance metric. The manuscript is self-contained despite discussing preregistration and implementation checks.
